programs.name: Washington Household Needs Grant (state Individual Assistance)
programs.summary: A state cash grant for households whose primary home was destroyed or had major damage from a wildfire on or after June 14, 2026.
eligibility: Primary residence destroyed or majorly damaged
Income and insurance do not disqualify you

how.label: In person: S.C.O.P.E. North Station, 33 E Lincoln Rd, Suite 203 (Fri–Sat)

deadline.note: The state's page does not publish an application deadline. Call 2-1-1 to confirm it is still open. Appeals are due within 30 days of a decision notice.
